requirements.title: W03 cold scenario includes W04 Parquet persist, so the reported cold peak is contaminated by cache write memory
requirements.minimal_owner_action: Make --scenario cold a no-persist cold build or capture and use a pre-persist peak through first I03/I05; keep persistence in full-matrix/separate stage and report both peaks; add a test that cold does not call ParquetC11Carrier.persist (or that W03 uses only the pre-persist peak), and that a compact-only change with unchanged pre-persist peak cannot pass.
requirements.acceptance_effect: Blocks W03/W34 receiving until fixed and rerun at exact 100k.

requirements.title: Stage RSS is cumulative process high-water, not a stage peak; projection/object/hash are not actually measured
requirements.minimal_owner_action: Record stage entry/exit current RSS and a true per-stage peak (sampling or isolated child); keep process_ru_maxrss separate; measure actual projection or label it combined with profile setup; add a regression test where a post-high-water allocation changes only the stage peak.
requirements.acceptance_effect: Blocks W03 receiving until stage peaks are real.

requirements.title: 6 GiB cap is installed after profile/cell construction, and the author 100k receipt reports cap_enforced false
requirements.minimal_owner_action: Set the limit before profile/cell construction, ideally in a small launcher before bench imports/data construction; record enforcement as a precondition of every run; if the platform cannot enforce it, emit BLOCKED_EXACT_DEPENDENCY; add a low-cap over-limit test.
requirements.acceptance_effect: Blocks any 100k acceptance claim until the cap is effective and recorded.

requirements.title: Cold-only baseline pairing crashes; baseline identity and the 15%/90%/10%-RSS/retention gates are not enforced
requirements.minimal_owner_action: Fix the cold-only lookup; bind the baseline to protected 4f3413fc, same rows/profiles/repetitions/host, exact command and output hash; compare stage and aggregate values; hard-fail nonzero on NO_BASELINE/mismatch/unmet 15% RSS, >10% RSS regression, or >90% warm restart wall; add explicit retention; test cold-only baseline, no baseline, wrong rows/host, and threshold failure.
requirements.acceptance_effect: Blocks W03/W34 receiving; final same-HQ-SHA 100k 3-repeat receipt required.

requirements.title: Source-open and repeat/retention economics are asserted rather than measured
requirements.minimal_owner_action: Instrument actual source opens or emit explicit NOT_APPLICABLE__SOURCEFREE_SYNTHETIC_STREAM; count cache reads/writes and run at least two fresh-process warm restarts from the same persisted cache; compute amortization from actual uses/bytes; add a nonbeneficial persist case and an explicit retention decision with a test.
requirements.acceptance_effect: W34 repeat/retention evidence is incomplete; no whole W34 acceptance.

scope: Existing frozen W03/W04/W34 obligations; no new scope or gate
delivery: HQ acceptance checklist; not claimed delivered into busy OpenCode session
full_scale_run: Hold until corrected method independently checked and final candidate pinned
